name: omnilab/tides
description: Omnilab Tides: NOAA CO-OPS (Tides and Currents) - a station's water level every six minutes, verified hourly heights and highs and lows, tide predictions (every six minutes, hourly, or the highs and lows), water and air temperature as series, at a station named or the nearest one of a point, cut to the API's length limits; a station as an entity; through the CO-OPS Data and Metadata APIs, no key needed.
